rows.corpus_definition: Someone who is honest and can be counted on.
rows.example_en: He is a trustworthy person who always tells truth.

rows.corpus_definition: To push the edge of something into a small space.
rows.example_en: Please tuck your shirt into your trousers.

rows.corpus_definition: To fall down suddenly in an uncontrolled way.
rows.example_en: He watched the small child tumble on the grass.

rows.corpus_definition: The state of not having a job when you want one.
rows.example_en: High unemployment causes many social problems in the city.

rows.corpus_definition: Being the only one of its kind.
rows.example_en: Every person has a unique voice.

rows.corpus_definition: Moving toward a higher place or position.
rows.example_en: He looked upwards at the tall building.

rows.corpus_definition: Relating to a city or a large town.
rows.example_en: He enjoys the fast urban life.

rows.corpus_definition: Completely or in every single way.
rows.example_en: I was utterly exhausted after the long race.

rows.corpus_definition: A medicine given to help the body fight a specific disease.
rows.example_en: The new vaccine helps prevent the flu.

rows.corpus_definition: Something that is acceptable and can be used officially.
